summary:
I reviewed the favourites build against the ioq3 1.36 source, the staged binaries, the captured box files and the live service DB. Nothing was written to the share or any box, and no service was touched. The five asked-for changes are correct, but I found and fixed three defects in place in scripts/gameindex (nothing is committed).

What holds up:
1. Label injection. The ioq3 1.36 Cbuf_Execute (read from the git object at 06954842) splits at ';' even inside a '//' comment, so the injection was real. clean_label closes it.
2. servercache.dat layout. I disassembled the staged ioquake3.x86.exe (md5 12f99bc0…) myself:
   - LAN_LoadCachedServers compares the size with 0xA9200, reads 0xA4000 + 0x5200 bytes, and opens "servercache.dat".
   - NET_CompareBaseAdr compares only the 4 ip bytes for type 4, never ip6, so the ownership mark is safe.
   - The sample output differs from the captured .123 file only in the favourite count and record 0.
3. BUSY per file, the latin-1 round trip and the no-MKDIR rule are right. The ports in the skip reasons match scripts/game-servers/gameservers.py.
4. I rendered all 43 captured box files: none changes a line outside the favourites.

Defects fixed:
1. Team Arena reported success when the fleet server was not added. If the player's 128 favourites fill the list, or the address is a hostname, it said "unchanged: … ours: none". With no file on the box it also created an empty servercache.dat. It now reports "skipped: … NOT ADDED <addr> - <why>" and creates no file unless something of ours goes in it.
2. Q3 favourites still churned on real data. I replayed the captured box files through 7 real service passes (read-only DB copies, 05:04-05:49):
   - The builder's code rewrote all 7 Q3 autoexecs in 3 of them. Each time it was an incumbent that had simply not been re-probed for 15 minutes; one server went in and out, and a sibling port on the same host replaced another.
   - The cause: what the masters return varies (389 addresses at 05:34, 862 either side), and a third of the listed servers do not answer any one probe.
   - Fix: db.best_servers now judges an incumbent over the 1-hour window prune_servers keeps a row for. It still needs players at its last probe; a newcomer still needs 15 minutes.
   - Result: one rewrite, for a server unseen for over an hour, then none.
3. The SoF2 skip reason said "the staged tree carries base\servercache.dat". No such file is staged, checked case-insensitively; the game writes it at its tree root on the boxes. Reworded.

I also corrected the launcher list (it missed SoldierOfFortune2/base/mp/autoexec.cfg, which is the live multiplayer autoexec), the hardware plan, and the risks. The 8 tests I added bring test_patch_favourites.py to 96; the favourites suites pass 287 of 287.
launcher_changes_needed:
LIBRARY (staged configs, another agent; the favourites code needs nothing staged). In staged Quake-family autoexec.cfg files, replace each ';' that sits outside quotes in a '//' comment with ' -'. Q2 3.20, Q3 1.32 and ioq3 1.36 Cbuf_Execute split the line there and run the rest as a command (ioq3 1.36 cmd.c confirmed from the source). Match by comment TEXT, not line number: the SoF2 tree was edited on the share by another session at 05:14 and again at 05:39 today, and its line moved 36 -> 46 -> 36. Current list, from a case-insensitive scan of every staged autoexec.cfg (a Cbuf-exact splitter, _-dirs excluded):
- Quake3-TeamArena/baseq3/autoexec.cfg and missionpack/autoexec.cfg: '...rewritten on exit; this is not.' and '...\screenshots\;'.
- Quake2Complete/{baseq2,rogue,xatrix}/autoexec.cfg and Quake2Win9x/baseq2/autoexec.cfg: 'has no +use; invuse is its action key' (runs `invuse` at every start) and 'always run; nobody wants...'.
- JediAcademy/base/autoexec.cfg: '...rewritten on exit; this file is not.'.
- SoldierOfFortune/base/autoexec.cfg: '...the form that works; an earlier pass...'.
- SoldierOfFortune2/base/autoexec.cfg: '...did nothing; it is removed so nobody'.
- SoldierOfFortune2/base/mp/autoexec.cfg (MISSED by the builder; it is the LIVE multiplayer autoexec, since sof2mp.exe's game dir is base/MP): three comment lines ('...stayed at 640x480; the', '...every texture; every fleet card...', '...for SoF2; that is an engine limit...').
- SiNGold/{base,ctf,2015}/autoexec.cfg: six comment lines each, including the awk one-liner.
Shogo/autoexec.cfg has one too, but LithTech's console is not Quake's Cbuf and its ';' behaviour is unverified; leave it unless proven.
No file here is written by GAMERES or FLEETRES (GAMERES only writes Shogo's autoexec), so there is no writer fight, and no parentheses are generated. Then run the purge + GAMESYNC fix loop on every box.

tests/README.md (shared index file). tests/python/test_readme_lists_every_test.py fails until a row exists; it already fails on master for test_sharewrite.py and for every test_patch_*.py. Add this row to the 'Fix -> test coverage' table:
| **favourites agent 2026-09-29: a public hostname in a Q3/Q2 favourites comment could run console commands (Cbuf splits at ';' inside //); Team Arena favourites via ioquake3 1.36 servercache.dat (layout pinned to the staged binary; a fleet server the list cannot take is NOT ADDED, never 'unchanged'); BUSY per FILE and case-insensitive; a settled box says unchanged (incumbents judged over the 1 h prune window, stable slots, semantic compare, seeds not deduped by host, first-reply RTT); no MKDIR above a title folder; RTCW/Deus Ex writers were false successes; stale UNWRITABLE reasons corrected** | `scripts/gameindex/{favorites,sync,db,masters}.py` | `python/test_patch_favourites.py` |

CLAUDE.md, 'One Staged Tree, Eight Monitors', id Tech 3 bullet. The parenthetical '(retro-gameindex writes one)' is false. No gameindex code has ever referenced APPDATA until the new Team Arena servercache.dat writer, and no box has that autoexec. Suggested wording: 'a per-user %APPDATA%\Quake3\baseq3\autoexec.cfg would SHADOW the staged file entirely (none exists on the fleet as of 2026-09-29; retro-gameindex writes the install tree's autoexec.cfg, plus %APPDATA%\Quake3\servercache.dat for Team Arena's favourites)'.

retro-3dfx/FINDINGS.md (findings log; outside this area), newest first:
(a) Q2/Q3 Cbuf_Execute splits at ';' outside quotes even inside a // comment, so comment text after the ';' runs as a command.
(b) Team Arena's Favorites tab is the ENGINE's list in %APPDATA%\Quake3\servercache.dat, not server1..16. The ioq3 1.36 layout: a 12-byte header whose size field is 692736, then 4096+128 records of 164 bytes, with netadr_t 32 bytes and the port in network order. NET_CompareBaseAdr never reads ip6 for NA_IP.
(c) The staged WON Half-Life is protocol 45 (hw.dll cmp eax,2Dh), not 46.
(d) Discovery does not re-probe every server every pass: the masters' answer varies (389 vs 862 addresses) and a third of the listed servers do not answer any one probe. A 'keep what the box lists' rule must judge liveness over the prune window, not the newcomer window, or it churns.

LIBRARY doc: JediAcademy/SERVERS-fleet.txt still says the client is blocked by 'Disk 1 not in drive'. README-FLEET.txt beside it records the disc-mount fix and a two-box join on 2026-08-31, so SERVERS-fleet.txt should be updated to match (verified on the share).

OPTIONAL, agent release (not needed by this change): GAMEINDEX signatures for FarCry.exe and DOOM3.exe. Their UNWRITABLE answers exist, but the titles are invisible to the host without a signature.
Correction to the builder's note: .110/.123/.171 sharing GAMEINDEX hash 9f4d3d9b is harmless in itself. The hash sums FNV-1a of key|dir|exe for every entry (agent/src/gameindex.c build_json), so equal hashes mean identical indexes. The real risk is a different machine taking an IP while its re-index fails, and this build no longer writes then. Keying favorites_state and installed_games by hostname (FAV-8/N3) is still the durable fix.
tests:
Run from the worktree:
python3 -m pytest -q tests/python/test_gameindex*.py tests/python/test_patch_favourites.py tests/python/test_autodeploy.py tests/python/test_host_duties.py tests/python/test_unrealgold_server.py
→ 287 passed with the share mounted.
- test_patch_favourites.py has 96 tests: the builder's 88 plus 8 of mine.
- The share-walking test takes about 25 s on CIFS.
- With the library path pointed at a missing directory: 91 passed, 5 SKIPPED LOUDLY ('...is not mounted - this check reads the staged library and did NOT run').

My 8 new tests. Six of them FAIL against the builder's version; I ran them in a scratch tree with the builder's modules. The seventh ('an incumbent gone for an hour or last seen empty is replaced') passes on both, as the guard that the fix does not keep dead servers. The eighth is the SoF2 share test.
- A full favourites list is reported 'skipped: … NOT ADDED <addr> - the favourites list is full', never 'unchanged', and the file is left byte-identical.
- A hostname fleet address is reported 'NOT ADDED … not an IPv4', and no empty servercache.dat is created.
- sc_merge creates no file when nothing of ours goes in it.
- A player's own copy of the fleet server is named in the report.
- An incumbent last seen 30 minutes ago is kept, while a newcomer that old is refused.
- An incumbent unseen for 70 minutes, or last seen empty, is replaced.
- End to end: 5 listed servers aged 25 minutes gives 'unchanged' and no upload; aged 70 minutes, they are replaced.
- Share test: the SoF2 reason matches the tree. No servercache.dat is staged (case-insensitive). mp.pk3 vm/sof2mp_ui.qvm has addFavorite and no server%d. sof2mp.exe names servercache.dat.

Offline checks (evidence in .claude/evidence-1080p/review-build-favourites/):
- replay-results.txt: 43 captured box files through 7 real passes (read-only DB copies 05:04-05:49).
  - Builder, writes per pass: [16, 7, 7, 0, 0, 0, 0].
  - Reviewed, writes per pass: [9, 7, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0].
  - The .240 detail shows each builder rewrite was an incumbent 15-30 minutes old that still reported players. The one reviewed rewrite is a server unseen for over an hour.

- The servercache sample differs from the captured .123 original only at header offset 4 (numfav 0 -> 1) and record 0 at 671756.

Full tests/python run, 2 failures, neither in this area:
- test_readme_lists_every_test: needs the tests/README.md row above.
- test_mount_launcher_template::test_shipped_launcher_matches_its_spec[SoldierOfFortune2]: another session modified 'Play Soldier of Fortune II.bat' and base\autoexec.cfg on the share at 05:39 today.
risks: Team Arena's writer is proven from the ioq3 source and the staged binary, but not yet seen on screen. UICLICK does not drive TA's mouse-only Source control, so the Favorites check may need a person at the box once.

Deliberate trade from the review fix: a listed internet Q3 server that stops answering stays in the file for up to an hour (the prune horizon) instead of 15 minutes. The Q3 browser shows it with no ping until then. One that empties is still replaced on the next pass. To revert, pass incumbent_fresh_s=fresh_s.

Q3 files still change for real events: a listed server empties at its last probe (humans only now), stays unanswered for over an hour, or a new local server appears. A pass-2 'wrote' for Q3 is not by itself a defect. 'The same file rewritten on consecutive passes with nothing changed in the world' is.

The replay's player counts come from the running pre-change code, which counts bots. After deploy, the first pass rewrites each Q3 autoexec once wherever a bot-only server was listed, as the builder said.

GAMESYNC still copies the staged text files back over the favourites (the F1 fight; the fix is agent-side). A pass after any GAMESYNC rewrites them with an identical hash. servercache.dat lives in %APPDATA% and is never reverted.
The service runs sync.py from the MAIN tree (/home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent, unit WorkingDirectory). Restarting it before master is fast-forwarded there deploys nothing new.

Only ioquake3 reads %APPDATA%\Quake3\servercache.dat. On a box where FLEETGL.BAT picks the retail quake3.exe (a Voodoo 2 at or below 800x600), Team Arena's Favorites stay empty. This is harmless, and no LCD box takes that path.

A servercache.dat in any other layout (a newer ioquake3 on .195/.246's legacy C:\Quake III Arena\Quake3) is refused with FAILED on every pass, so the wall shows it. .195's file was the 1.36 layout (md5 1d9ecd77) when captured.

When titles with different policies share one file (e.g. .145 C:\Sierra\Half-Life ts+tfc), the first key's list is written. That is the same as the old code's 'same file as', but there is no line saying so. It is inert today: that WON tree has no serverbrowser.vdf, so it is skipped.
Old blocks stay on the boxes: RTCW Main\autoexec.cfg, the Deus Ex section, the phantom baseq3 folders, q3bench and the .249 leftovers. All are inert; cleanup is FAV-8/FAV-12.
Every pass DOWNLOADs the 692,748-byte servercache.dat from each ioquake3+missionpack box. That is LAN traffic only.
The SoF2 staged tree is being edited by another session right now (05:14 and 05:39 today). The library ';' edit must be made against the current files, matched by comment text.

review_notes:
WHAT I VERIFIED
- Labels: the injection is real. ioq3 1.36 cmd.c Cbuf_Execute (git object 06954842, read-only) breaks on ';' when the quotes so far are even, and on \n/\r, with no notion of comments. clean_label and the 'clean' rule in same_favourites close it. I also considered '$' for Q2 (Cmd_MacroExpandString expands it even in comments). The worst case is losing one favourite line and nothing was proven, so I left it.
- servercache.dat, from my own objdump of the staged ioquake3.x86.exe (md5 12f99bc0…, 1,363,456 B):
  - LAN_LoadCachedServers @0x41cc40 compares the size with 0xa9200 and reads 0xa4000 and 0x5200 bytes; the name pointer 0x51b6d0 is 'servercache.dat'.
  - NET_CompareBaseAdr @~0x444440: for type 4 it runs repz cmpsb over the 4 ip bytes with ecx=4; ip6 plus scope_id are compared only for type 5.
  - The 1.36 source confirms that only the TA UI (code/ui) calls Load/Save; q3_ui never does. FS_SV_FOpenFileRead tries homepath first, then basepath.
  - REGREAD's quoted-path and value form exists since agent 1.60.0, and its reply shape matches box_appdata.
  - The sample merge differs from the captured .123 file only at offset 4 and record 0.
- Every port named in the UNWRITABLE reasons matches scripts/game-servers/gameservers.py.
- JKA: jamp.exe names servercache.dat, and uix86.dll in assets2/3.pk3 has addFavorite and no server%d. RTCW and Deus Ex were checked by two earlier reviewers and I took them as verified.
- Rendering all 43 captured box files changes nothing outside the favourites.
- No game data or patched binary is under git. There is no provisioning/patches/favourites. The tests hold only md5s and a few instruction-byte signatures.

WHAT I CHANGED (all in scripts/gameindex and its tests; diff in .claude/evidence-1080p/review-build-favourites/reviewer-changes.diff; the builder's versions are kept in builder-version/)
1. Team Arena false success.
   - favorites.sc_merge now also returns 'wanted', and returns None (no file) when nothing is added or dropped, even with no file on the box.
   - New favorites.sc_missing() and sc_listing().
   - sync.push_servercache reports 'skipped: <path>: NOT ADDED … - <why>' instead of 'unchanged' when a wanted server is missing. It appends the NOT ADDED note to wrote/WOULD lines, and names a fleet server the player added himself.
2. Q3 churn.
   - db.best_servers gains incumbent_fresh_s=3600. It fetches rows back to that horizon, but a row older than fresh_s is kept only when it is an incumbent. Players>0 (or seed) and every accept filter still apply.
   - Measured against 7 real passes; see the tests field.
3. The SoF2 UNWRITABLE reason is reworded; the mechanism is re-proven from mp.pk3 and sof2mp.exe.
4. The README gains the incumbent window and the Team Arena NOT ADDED/retail-engine notes. There are 8 new tests.

WHERE THE BUILDER'S REPORT WAS WRONG OR INCOMPLETE
- 'From the second pass a settled box should report unchanged' was measured against the SAME DB snapshot for both passes. Against real consecutive passes the builder's code rewrote the 7 Q3 files in 3 of 7 passes. That is now fixed, and the hardware plan says what a Q3 'wrote' may legitimately mean.
- 'A full list is reported rather than forced': sc_merge recorded it, but push_servercache printed 'unchanged'. Fixed.
- launcher_changes_needed missed SoldierOfFortune2/base/mp/autoexec.cfg, the live MP autoexec with 3 splitting comments. It also gave line numbers for a file another session is editing; it is now matched by comment text.
- The same-hash note was misleading: equal hashes mean identical indexes (the hash covers key|dir|exe).

LEFT FOR THE LEAD, not changed
- Filtering baseq3's internet list to gamename baseq3. Today UrT (q3urt43), CPMA and OSP servers can be listed, e.g. 212.83.165.57:27962 'SU.net FunTDM' q3urt43 was picked by the builder's code at 05:04. Stock clients cannot join them without the mod. The builder flagged the same trade-off (strict_accepts=True on quake3/ioquake3), and it is a policy decision.
- Per-file policy conflict visibility (the ts+tfc case above).
- FAV-8 pruning and hostname keying.

State: nothing committed or deployed. The read-only DB snapshot loop I ran for the replay is stopped. Suites: the favourites suites pass 287 of 287; the full tests/python run fails only the two tests named in the tests field, neither in this area.
